procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (43 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side 1-45 in order, no repeats or gaps. Answer side 1-25, unnumbered match block (6 rows), 27-44; q045 no key. Difficulty per question: easy 32, average 7, difficult 6, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 91 (heading, LO 4 bullets, q1-8) 92-94; A pdf 186-188.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following with right answers.(Easy)' q26 (6 rows); s5 one mark q27-31 vsa; s6 two marks q32-36 sa; s7 three marks q37-40 sa; s8 four marks q41-45 la.

q5 option D 'Underdevelopment' wraps to the next line (set by hand). q42 key: 'Past life:' / 4 bullets / 'Present life:' / 4 bullets — sub-headings are not steps. q44 key opens with the printed instruction '(You may draw pictures …)' -> heading, not a step.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_22.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
